meta.title: Pengrim | Sport Advertising
meta.description: Pengrim connects brands with LED perimeter signage, stadium inventory, and broadcast visibility for sporting events. It manages the entire process, from match and league selection to reporting.

hero.headline: Take your brand pitchside and on-screen.
hero.subline: The right match, the right league, the right audience.

static.title: In-stadium inventory

broadcast.title: Broadcast visibility
